policies.title: Paternity leave
policies.content: All employees are entitled to 4 weeks of fully paid paternity leave within the first 12 months after a child's birth or adoption. Leave can be taken in one block or in two separate two-week blocks. Notify HR at least 4 weeks in advance. Stacking with vacation is permitted but the combined absence cannot exceed 8 consecutive weeks without VP approval.

policies.title: Vacation balance
policies.content: Standard balance is 25 vacation days per year, accrued monthly. Carry-over capped at 5 days into Q1 of the next year. Stacking with paternity or sabbatical leave requires HR pre-approval. Vacation cannot be taken during code-freeze weeks declared by Engineering.

policies.title: GDPR right to erasure
policies.content: Employees may request deletion of their personal data via hr@acme.nl. HR confirms within 30 days. Audit log entries are retained for 7 years per EU AI Act and are not subject to erasure; aggregated metrics with the identity stripped are retained.

policies.title: Expense reimbursement
policies.content: Submit expenses within 30 days of incurring them. Travel: economy class for flights under 6 hours, premium economy for 6+ hours. Per diem of EUR 50 / day for meals. Receipts above EUR 25 must be uploaded to the expense portal. Manager pre-approval required for purchases over EUR 500.

policies.title: 1-1 escalation path
policies.content: If a 1-1 issue cannot be resolved with your direct manager, the escalation path is: manager -> skip-level manager -> HR business partner (HRBP) -> Head of HR. Anonymous reports may be filed via hr-anonymous@acme.nl which routes only to HRBP and Head of HR.

policies.title: Code freeze windows
policies.content: Engineering declares code-freeze for the two weeks preceding any quarterly launch. During code-freeze: vacation requests deferred unless pre-approved, only critical bug fixes ship, and oncall coverage is doubled.
